breaks.quote: So what I realised is, that's why I almost never finish anything.
breaks.why: Thinking out loud kept as said: the stumbling "So what I realised is" opener, and as the passage's first line "that's why" points to nothing, so the reader has to guess.

breaks.quote: "That's always been my mindset," she said. "Can you picture it?"
breaks.why: "Can you picture it?" has nothing to picture and reads as a stray spoken fragment, so the reader has to guess what she means.
